d:
Mining in the wild comes with serious risks, especially when massive machines break down or get stuck in tough terrain. From equipment failures and dangerous breakdowns to challenging recovery missions, these moments put the miners and their operations to the test. Can the crews get their machinery back in action before precious mining time runs out?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 2, 5, 7 and 11; and Season 6, Episodes 4, 5, 11, 13 and 17, on Discovery Channel India.
